parties:
Nabir Md. @ Nabiruddin ----- Appellant
Vs.
The State ----- Respondent
full_judgment: 2. The case for the prosecution in brief is as follows: P.W. 1 Abdur Rouf who lived in Village Dokchai, P.S. Bochaganj, District Dinajpur used to deal in rice and paddy. Deceased Matiar Rahman as his cousin as well as partner On 31.8.69 corresponding to 14th Bbadra, 1376 B.S. at about 10 A.M. he was going to Krishnapur in a bullock cart to purchase paddy. He had with him Tk. 1200/- P.W. 2 Hamidul alias Khendela Md. was driving the bullock cart. The house of Matiar ahman is by the side of the road. When P.W. 1 Abdur Rouf reached near the house of deceased Matiar Rahman, he called him (the deceased). PW 1 Abdur Rouf got down from the bullock cart and proceeded towards a bush near the bank of a tank to answer the call of nature. The place was about 6/7 rashis to the north of the house of deceased Matiar Rahman. Acquitted accused Emaj caught hold of P.W. 1 Abdur Rouf and started giving him fists and blows P.W. 1 Rouf raised alarm. Acquitted accused Serajuddin, Faziruddin, Abdus Sattar and Azizul Huq appeared and started assaulting him. Accused Emajuddin snatched away the Mathir (a bag made of cloth) containing Tk. 1200/- from P.W. 1 Rouf and handed over the same to accused Fazir who ran away. His cousins P.W. 4 Mukhlesur Rahman and deceased Matiar kahman came to his rescue. P.W. 4 Mukhlesur Rahman caught hold of accused A zizul Huq and deceased Matiar Rahman caught hold of accused Seraj. The other accused persons fled away informant P.W. 3 Nazrui Islam and P.W. 5 Tafidul Hoque (cousins of P.W. 1 Rouf) came and helped them in arresting accused Azizul Huq and accused Seraj and disarming them. Accused Azizul Huq had a scythe (Exhibit 1) and accused Emajuddin had an umbrella, Exhibit II. They started for the Thana with the arrested accused Azizul Huq, accused Seraj and accused Emajuddin. On the way they met P.W. 7 Abdul Jalil (uncle of deceased Matiar Rahman) who asked them as to what had happened. They narrated the occurrence to him. At that time accused Azizul Huq managed to escape from the custody of PW. 3 Nazrul Islam. Seeing the accused party men coming to attack them PW. 3 Nazrul Islam went to the Police Station and lodged F.I.R. at 11-40 hours narrating the part of occurrence he had seen and requesting the police to come immediately to arrest the accused persons. While P.W. 3 Nazrul Islam had gone away to Thana, accused appellant Nabiruddin along with other accused party men came in a body and attacked the complainant party. Accused Emajuddin and Serajuddin were under the arrest of the complainant party and they were guarding them. Accused appellant Nabiruddin was armed with a Kora. Accused Abdus Samad had a ballam. The remaining accused persons had lathis. The accused persons attacked the complainant party in the khatian of P.W. 7 Abdul Jalil. Out of fear they released arrested accused Emajuddin and accused Serajuddin. The complainant party entered the courtyard of the house of P.W. 7 Jalil by the gate (Exhibit III) which was made of tin. Accused Emajuddin took a lathi from the hand of accused Fazir and accused Seraj who took a lathi from the hand of accused Khoka dealt lathi blows on deceased. Matiar Rahman. Accused Azizul Huq also dealt a lathi blow on deceased Matiar Rahman. Accused Bshu dealt a lathi blow on P. W. 1 Rouf's back. Accused Milan Bepari gave a blow by lathi on the right hand of P. W. 7 Jalil. Accused appellant Nabiruddin gave a blow by Kora on the left chest of deceased Matiar Rahman who fell down on the ground and expired within 5/6 minutes. Thereafter the accused persons fled away. The complainant party arrested accused Fazir. After about half an hour P. W. 3 Nazrul Islam came to the place of occurrence with the police and found the the dead body of Matiar Rahman. P. W. II Dr. M. A. Sattar, Assistant Surgeon, Dinajpur Sadar Hospital held post mortem examination on the dead body of Matiar Rahman on 1.9.69. Sub-Inspector Abdus Salam (who was dead at the time of trial) investigated into the case and submitted charge-sheet against accused appellant Nabiruddin alias Nabir Md. and 15 others on 13.9.69. A competent Magistrate held preliminary enquiry into the case and committed all the accused persons to the court of Sessions for trial. At the time of trial accused appellant Nabir Md. was charged under section 302 of the Penal Code. Accused appellant Nabir Md. and 15 others were charged under section 148 of the Penal Code for committing the offence of rioting with deadly weapons with the common object of assaulting the complainant party men and forcibly releasing accused Emajuddin and Serajuddin. The accused appellant and other co-accused pleaded not guilty to the charges. The case for the defence is that P. W. 7 Jalil's father was defeated by accused Emajuddin in the Basic Democracies election. Accused Emajuddin also brought a case under Section 379 of the Penal Code against P. W. 7 Jalil, deceased Matiar Rahman, P. W. 1 Rouf and others who were on bail. That case was fixed on 23.9.69 for examination of the prosecution witnesses P.W. 1 Rouf's mother had nika-married accused Emajuddin. The complaint party opposed the nika-marriage and out of that grudge they arrested accused Emajuddin from the bank of the tank with the help of P. W. 5 Tafidul Haque, P. W.10 Latifur Rahman, P. W. 7 Jalil and others. Accused Seraj came to the rescue of his brother accused Emajuddin and was arrested by the complaint party. Accused Emaj and accused Seraj were illegally confined in the house of P. W. 7 Jalil after being assaulted and dragged there. At that time the villagers came to the rescue of accused Emaj and accused Seraj. There was a melee and in that melee Matiar Rahman fell down on the ground, became senseless and subsequently died. No one saw Nabiruddin giving any blow by Kora (pointed bahuk) on the chest of Matiar Rahman. The complaint party got accused Fazir arrested by a police constable from his house. The prosecution has come up with a false story of a manner of occurrence. During the occurrence accused Emaj and accused Seraj were injured.
